arStrings.szText: While an enemy is {c_Important}{u}Eviscerated{/u}{/c}, your {c_important}Summoned Demons{/c} prioritize them and gain {c_number}[{SF_0} * 100|%|]{/c} increased Movement Speed. {c_important}Lesser Demon{/c} Skills gain a {c_number}[{SF_4}|%|]{/c} chance to {c_important}{u}Eviscerate{/u}{/c} enemies that are already {c_important}{u}Eviscerated{/u}{/c}.
